bucket_note: open record-level files, GPS 95-99%, KABCO, street pair + offset on every crash; catches: stale (newest 2022) and no licence text

sources.name: WisDOT Wisconsin Motor Vehicle Crash Annual Data Sets (DT4000 crash file), Division of State Patrol
sources.licence_quote: "The Wisconsin Department of Transportation (WisDOT) is now making its annual motor vehicle crash data sets available as open data." No licence or terms text (page version 20230916-001).
sources.years: DT4000 2017-2022 (legacy format 1994-2016, not read); 2023 on not posted
sources.street_names_note: ONSTR/ONHWY + ATSTR/ATHWY on 99.997% of 2022 crashes; distance (miles) and direction to the intersection on 77%; house number (ATCODE 101) on 12% statewide
sources.keys_linkable: CRSHNMBR joins person, vehicle, object files (only the crash file is read)

sources.name: Community Maps (UW TOPS Lab for WisDOT BOTS)
sources.access: open map + terms click-through; advanced download needs an account
sources.licence_quote: "Automated access, bulk data extraction, or use that degrades system performance is not permitted." "…intended for research purposes and to support traffic safety objectives."

placement_sample.note: TIGER-only network; auto = Gate() tiers with tiger_only_auto=True; WisDOT's offset distance and direction passed to locate.place. House numbers counted, not placed (NAD not checked).

end_to_end.corridor: W Capitol Dr (WIS 190), N 27th St to N 43rd St, Milwaukee (1.01 mi)

blockers: open files stop at 2022 (posted 2023-09): default window 2018-2022 (final_lag_months=46)
no licence text for paid use
Community Maps (2023-now) forbids automated access and bulk extraction
each year is a 70-97 MB zip on first use (cached as ~7 MB)
no statewide average rates read; no Wisconsin AADT in CrashIQ
user_actions: Optional: email DSPTrafficCrashes@dot.wi.gov to ask (a) when 2023+ annual files will be posted, (b) whether paid use of the open files is allowed
Optional, for current years: TOPS Lab data request (transportal.cee.wisc.edu/services/crash-data/requests/) or a Community Maps advanced account; needs the user's registration
